title: yadakchi.sellers.changed.v1
description:
Seller identity and trust, as catalog computes it.

Producers: catalog. Consumers: billing, ops.
Kafka message key: seller_key — it must be set; compaction and partition ordering depend on it.
Cleanup: compact, retention infinite.

This file validates a whole Kafka message body: the shared envelope from docs/specs/02-EVENT-CONTRACTS.md plus this topic's payload. Unknown fields are ignored, never rejected, at both levels — that is what lets a producer add an optional field without breaking a consumer.

event_id.description: UUIDv4, unique per emission. Two emissions of the same fact carry different event_ids; consumers deduplicate on the payload's natural identity, not on this.

event_type.description: The topic name without the 'yadakchi.' prefix and without the version suffix.

version.description: Envelope and payload version. A removed field, a renamed field or a changed type is a breaking change: publish to .v2 and run both until consumers migrate.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, ISO-8601 UTC with Z. Consumers tolerate out-of-order delivery across partitions by comparing this, never by assuming global ordering.

producer.description: The service that emitted this message. Constrained to the producers declared for this topic in platform/kafka/topics.yml.

trace_id.description: Propagated across the whole chain for debugging. Minted by crawler on yadakchi.listings.observed.v1 and carried through every derived event; a service starting a chain of its own (a human admin edit, a scheduled recomputation) mints a fresh one. Every service logs it.

payload.description: billing keeps its local seller read model from this topic and never calls catalog. Wallet balances are billing's own and are not on this topic. A tombstone — payload: null with the envelope intact — means this entity is deleted; compaction keeps it as the last word on the key.

seller_key.description: Stable slug of the seller, minted by crawler.

name.description: Display name, in Persian where the seller has one.

source_key.description: The crawl source this seller's listings arrive through, or null for a panel seller with no crawled source.

is_panel.description: true for a paying panel member with self-managed data. Crawled non-panel offers are displayed free and are never removed.

tier.description: Visibility tier. A new seller starts at 'new' with a capped trust ceiling — visibility is earned.

trust_score.description: Composite trust, driven mostly by observed price and stock accuracy because those are the signals we own and a seller cannot fake.

price_accuracy.description: Share of recrawls where the advertised price still held. null before enough observations exist.

stock_accuracy.description: Share of recrawls where "in stock" was still true. null before enough observations exist.

updated_at.description: When this seller record last changed.
